d:
This is the new Bugatti Destrier, an ultra-exclusive, one-off hypercar. It’s essentially a luxurious and (potentially) road-legal Bugatti Bolide, and the third member of Bugatti’s bespoke coach-built Solitaire family – following the Brouillard and FKP Homage. Power comes from a 1600hp quad-turbo 8.0-litre W16 engine, and in this video Bugatti boss Mate Rimac talks Top Gear around this new one-of-one hypercar that makes the upcoming V16 Tourbillon look tame!
